forms:
A Pokémon Center where you can feel the coziness
of wood. Inside, you can restore your PP.

Lights up when powered by electricity. It may increase
the comfort levels of nearby Pokémon.

The stained glass shines like jewels. This place feels
like it could hold something special.

A simple, modern Pokémon Center. You can copy
items inside.

A Pokémon Center with brightly shining sea glass.
It beautifully decorates the ocean basin.

Place a bed in the center to make this a bedroom.
One medium-sized Pokémon could live here.

It’s big enough to house one Pokémon. Fill it with
cool stuff, and it could be a secret base!

A large house that can fit two Pokémon. Change the
colors of the roof or walls as you see fit!

Big enough for four Pokémon to live in. A great place
to live together and have a wonderful time!

A simple den made of sand. It looks just about the
right size for one medium-sized Pokémon to live in.

A hut that one Pokémon could live in. The shells on
the walls look like stars in the sky.

It seems spacious enough for two Pokémon to live in.
Large furniture could comfortably fit inside as well!

A large house that four Pokémon could live in. Play
around with the colors of the windows and roof!

If you pile ’em up, even a bunch of stones can be a
home. One medium-sized Pokémon could live here.

A hut that one Pokémon could live in. Stone pillars
firmly support the entire structure.

The stone tiles on its large roof are neatly arranged.
Two Pokémon could live here.

A majestic house, complete with its own chimney!
It’s big enough for four Pokémon to live in.

A solid house made from sturdy materials.
One medium-sized Pokémon could live here.

A simple, stylish house. One Pokémon could
live here.

A modern house that also somehow feels nostalgic.
Large enough for two Pokémon to live in.

A house large enough for four Pokémon to live in.
It probably gets a good breeze from all the windows!

A shelter that can house one Pokémon. The entrance
is small, so you’ll have to crawl in.

A house big enough for one Pokémon. The interior
looks just like a Pokémon Center.

When powered by electricity, the lights will shine
brightly, and Pokémon will come in to make trades.

A machine used to charge Pokémon with electricity.
It needs electricity from a generator to run.

Simply place this anywhere to generate electricity.
If placed up high, it may generate more electricity.

If you place this in a river, it will start rotating. This
rotational motion is used to generate electricity.

This furnace’s flames can be harnessed to generate
electricity. Try burning whatever you don’t need!

Pikachu surfing on a big wave. Light it up to give the
surrounding area an electrifying atmosphere!

A mural that once depicted a Pokémon. If you could
find the scattered pieces and reconstruct it...

You can make all sorts of things in the workshop or
have fun in the play area.

Lots of machines are constantly running back behind
this peaceful cafeteria.

This book-lined floor has a stately atmosphere. Sit in
the fancy chair to feel like a company president.

An altar built on a volcano. The burning torches light
the way.

A facility with lots of rugged-looking machinery in it.
When powered, it runs all on its own.

A pair of shockingly cold mountains. They resemble
a temple and give off a mystical atmosphere.

A big pot of curry that everyone helped make. If you
eat it together, you’ll become even better friends.

A statue that makes you feel like dancing. Place it
somewhere to sharply raise the nearby mood!

A colorful cottage with a splendid tiled roof.
It’s large enough for two Pokémon to live in.

A luxurious house with a magnificent tiled roof.
It’s large enough for four Pokémon to live in.

A submarine large enough for two Pokémon to live in.
It looks too complicated to operate.

A glamorous temple full of seashells, seaweed, and
coral. It feels like an ocean paradise.

A clock tower that features a cute Dewgong and Seel.
When the clock strikes a certain time...

A park with a Chansey tree as its landmark. It’s lush
with greenery and looks nice and relaxing.

A cute, slightly retro house with a tile roof and
stucco walls.

Power on the cash register to open for business.
Pokémon will drop by to take a quick break.

A gorgeous house with an orange roof. It would fit in
perfectly at a seaside resort.

The lights and sound system are ready to go. Bring
hype-building Pokémon here to dance.

A high-class house with a serene atmosphere. It’s full
of luxurious furniture.

A simple room designed with ease of work in mind.
It has everything needed for an office job.

This house has both a bathtub and a kitchen. The
second-floor loft is quite stylish.

A house made by stacking lots of logs together.
You can feel the coziness of wood here.

An eye-catching fountain and bell adorn this plaza.
This would make a great meeting place.

A hut with a distinctive orange roof. Its mix of plaster
and brick gives it a stylish vibe.

A gray hut made out of stone. Its blue roof gives it a
slightly cool impression.

Its cute, pink walls are 100 percent plaster and pair
perfectly with its tiled roof.

A showy hut with eye-catching yellow walls.
Going inside may cheer you up!

A house with a cute aqua-colored scale roof. It’s full
of furniture that gives the place an ocean vibe.

A high-tech lab that even has its own server. Shut the
doors and windows to make it completely waterproof.

A well-stocked supermarket that even has TMs and
Poké Balls.
